title: Official Last Light Rp
description: Last Light RP is a zombie apocalypse roleplay server where players survive in a ruined world filled with infected, abandoned cities, and scarce resources. Scavenge, build alliances, and fight to stay alive—because in the end, only the last light remains.
body:
Last Light RP is a zombie apocalypse roleplay server built for Minecraft 1.20.1 using a curated collection of survival and immersion mods. The project focuses on creating a harsh post-apocalyptic environment where players must scavenge resources, survive infected hordes, explore ruined cities, and interact with other survivors through roleplay. The modpack and server configuration are designed to support faction building, player trading, survival progression, and story-driven encounters in a world where resources are limited and danger is constant.

The purpose of this project is to provide a structured roleplay experience centered around survival, exploration, and player interaction in a zombie-infested world. Players can explore abandoned locations, secure safe zones, form alliances, or compete with other survivors while navigating the challenges of the apocalypse.
